name: kb
description: Read and write the persistent graph knowledge base — a growing set of linked notes that survives across sessions. Use it to record research findings, architecture decisions, and what you learn about a codebase, then link notes together with [[Wikilinks]] so related knowledge connects up over time. Search it BEFORE researching something from scratch: a prior session may have already answered it. Actions: 'search' (find notes), 'read' (one note), 'write' (create/replace), 'append' (add to an existing note — preferred for iterative research), 'links' (a note's outgoing links, backlinks and dangling targets), 'graph' (whole-vault shape: hubs, orphans, and the frontier of not-yet-written notes).

title.description: Note title — the wikilink identity. Required for read/write/append/links.

content.description: Markdown body for write/append. Link to other notes with [[Their Title]]; linking generously is the point.

kind.description: Classification for a written note, e.g. research, decision, codebase, howto.

summary.description: One-line summary stored in frontmatter, shown in search results.
